name: Maintenance updates vehicle shop status
instruction: Maintenance lifecycle handlers must keep the vehicle status in sync with whether maintenance is in progress or complete.
relevant_when: JavaScript controller file that creates, completes, updates, or deletes Maintenance records and has access to the related Vehicle model.
context: README.md and backend/API_DOCUMENTATION.md document maintenance auto-status behavior: creating a maintenance log moves the vehicle to In Shop, and completing maintenance returns the vehicle to Available.
scope_reason: The maintenance controller contains the maintenance creation, completion, and deletion flows that own vehicle shop status transitions.

checklist.name: creation-marks-in-shop
checklist.rule: When the file defines maintenance log creation, that flow finds the related vehicle and sets its status to In Shop after creating the in-progress maintenance log; return not applicable if the file does not define maintenance creation.

checklist.name: completion-marks-available
checklist.rule: When the file defines marking maintenance complete, that flow returns the related vehicle from In Shop to Available; return not applicable if the file does not define maintenance completion.

checklist.name: in-progress-delete-releases-vehicle
checklist.rule: When the file defines deleting an In Progress maintenance log, that flow returns the related In Shop vehicle to Available or otherwise explicitly preserves a correct non-available status; return not applicable if the file does not define maintenance deletion.
